title: Salta Diya
description: A rich man's wife and a thief's wife simultaneously give birth to twin sons, two of whom are accidentally exchanged. Years later, an unexpected event leads them to swap places once again.

title: Love Mocktail
description: Adi meets someone on the way to Udupi and talks about what he experienced the three different times he has been in love.

title: Pyar Ki Kahani
description: A well-qualified man working as a peon helps another young man get a job in his office as a manager. When the peon's marriage is arranged, his friend doesn't approve of the girl, but the groom discovers the truth behind the disapproval.

title: Pighalta Aasman
description: A businesswoman travels to Kashmir to settle a property issue; she falls in love with a man there. Her best friend also falls in love with the same person, this changes their relationship forever.

title: Main Intequam Loonga
description: An engaged boxer learns lies about his childhood and that his famed boxer father was killed for not throwing a fight, a fact he now wants to avenge.

title: Josh
description: It's 1980 in the coastal town of Vasco. Two gangs fight for control of the streets: the Scorpions, led by Prakash (Sharad Kapoor), and the Eagles, fronted by Max (Shahrukh Khan). When Prakash's brother Rahul (Chandrachur Singh) comes to visit, he meets and quickly falls in love with Shirley (Aishwarya Rai), not realizing she's the sister of his brother's rival, Max. Though Rahul tries to keep their relationship secret, it's only a matter of time before it brings the gang rivalry to a head.

title: Pyar Ke Kabil
description: A young couple split up not long after getting married, even splitting up their twin children. Several years later, the twins are reunited and decide to switch places to try and bring their parents together again.

title: Biwi.Com
description: A married man's life changes after a pandit predicts that he is destined to marry thrice. Following that, his wife forces him into a second marriage, leading to arguments between the women. Things go haywire when a third woman enters their life.

title: Love Mocktail 2
description: Fate brings new love and some complications into Adi's life after his wife, Nidhi, dies. It is up to him whether he wants to embrace what lies ahead or to remain hung up on his past.

title: Farz
description: An agent in India's Secret Service probes the death of a fellow agent said to have had some evidence that would incriminate a terrorist leader.

title: Ghatak
description: Katya (Danny Denzongpa), a ruthless mobster, has taken control of a town on the outskirts of Mumbai, India. After violently putting down any uprising attempts, including murdering one man who publicly opposed him, Katya is challenged by Kashi (Sunny Deol), who has brought his sick father to town in search of medical attention. Kashi is outraged by what is happening in the village and confronts the criminal, but he is not prepared for the backlash that awaits him and his father.

title: Nazar Ke Samne
description: When Umesh is wrongly imprisoned for murder and given a death sentence, his lawyer has one week to track down the real killer.
